decision_skill.name: validated_damped_local_trend
decision_skill.description: Use a recent-window linear trend only when backtesting shows it improves on a constant local-level forecast, then progressively damp its slope across the forecast horizon.
decision_skill.applicability: Short-horizon forecasting of locally trending series where recent observations permit rolling-origin comparison against a level baseline.
decision_skill.decision_rule: Compare candidate recent-window trends with a constant local-level forecast using rolling absolute error; select a trend only if at least one window performs better, and reduce the selected slope's contribution as forecast distance increases.
decision_skill.failure_condition: Do not use when no recent-window trend beats the level baseline, the inferred slope is unstable across validation windows, or structural breaks make recent drift unreliable.
